name: std::latch::try_wait
intro: Returns true only if the internal counter has reached zero. This function may spuriously return false with very low probability even if the internal counter has reached zero.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: With very low probability false, otherwise cnt == 0, where cnt is the value of the internal counter.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The reason why a spurious result is permitted is to allow implementations to use a memory order more relaxed than std::memory_order_seq_cst.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
